description: This Java source file defines the 'DeleteFeatures' command class used within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It allows for deleting all features of a specified Thing by providing its ThingId. The class includes methods for creating instances from parameters or JSON, and handles serialization/deserialization, headers, and command properties.
